authorization_gate.required: Primary sends explicit implementation-freeze message before any fresh search, candidate selection, retrieval or inspection.
receipt_fields: exact primary freeze notice or verbatim locator
runtime implementation and policy pin SHA256 list

target.native_text: Exact UTF-8 pdftotext extraction from retained input PDF; no OCR or alteration.
target.field_presence: Do not select for deadline or email presence, values or parser friendliness. Absent and conditional cases remain eligible.
target.runtime: No answers, adjudications, labels, decisive spans, verifier output or expected values in runtime manifest.

strict_eligibility.complete_notice: Only publisher-original PDF which itself is a complete standalone rulemaking notice, or official publisher-issued PDF corresponding to one complete notice with mechanically clear boundaries. Runtime scope full_notice.
strict_eligibility.registers: Never excerpt multi-notice registers, grouped issues or mixed packets. A notice in a register is eligible only if publisher distributes it as an individual complete notice PDF. Otherwise exclude and log.
strict_eligibility.no_substitution: No slice/unknown scopes to meet quotas. Do not truncate a notice. Report shortfall.
strict_eligibility.strata: General: proposed rulemaking notice inviting public comment. Control: explicitly conditional/relative comment/hearing terms or lifecycle cancellation, withdrawal, termination or related negative outcome. Stratum categories are not evaluation labels.
strict_eligibility.native_only: Empty, inaccessible, damaged native text, page-map mismatch or frozen input-contract size violation => exclude before runtime freeze. No OCR.

deduplication.reject: Earlier-round underlying notice, exact original PDF SHA256, or rehosted copy from Rounds 1–4. Compare source/docket identifiers, date, issuer, title, URL, hash and page identity.
deduplication.family: Distinct notices/PDFs may recur within a publisher template family; disclose. Unknown family does not establish novelty.

budget.input: Complete, unchanged publisher original PDF; no excerpts or page reduction.

retention: official publisher/discovery URLs and retrieval URL
unaltered original PDF bytes, hash, byte length
exact-copy input PDF, hash and page count
native.txt exact extraction bytes and hash
all pages rendered at >=150 DPI with tool version
dedup basis and known template-family recurrence

manifest.document_id: doc- plus first12 lowercase hex original SHA256
manifest.native_page_map_known: true only when form-feed page count equals PDF page count

bounded_operation.retries: At most one ordinary retry; no access-control bypass.
bounded_operation.after_q24: Resolve only that query’s already-bounded first-three candidate set and stop. No new search or continued queue processing.

exclusion_log_reasons: native text absent, damaged or over contract size
no eligible candidate within bounded plan
